canonical_project: Hyperco / TikTok Kouvola-Koria data center (Project Clover)
notes: TikTok: Hyperco building a Kouvola data center (Project Clover) under ~EUR 1bn investment; cornerstone ceremony held and construction begun. YVA page (Kouvolan datakeskus, Hyperco Data Systems Oy): operational phase ~100 MW IT, total electrical ~130 MW, backup-generator fuel power ~550 MW. Construction contractor Teraselementti involved in a 28,000 sqm phase.
